title: Irish Pasta Bake
description: A hearty, comforting casserole made with Irish sausage and pasta.
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, cook the Irish sausage over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the fried onion to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the herbs and cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked pasta, sausage mixture, and grated cheese.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and sprinkle with flour.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
